rounds.text: United Heat Transfer Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a P/E of 39.4x [E1] and a P/B of 3.11x [E2], which represents a massive discount when compared to sector benchmarks of 66.66x and 13.09x respectively [E6, E7]. The underlying operational performance reveals robust medium-to-long-term compounding, highlighted by a 5-year compounded profit growth of 27% [E17] and 3-year compounded profit growth of 33% [E18]. This profitability is backed by pristine cash generation, evidenced by a March 2026 cash conversion ratio of 1.61x producing Rs 8.08 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 1.75 Cr in free cash flow [E28, E29, E30]. Furthermore, margin expansion is well underway with the annual operating margin reaching 14% against 11% three years prior [E24], and quarterly operating margins leaping to 15% in March 2026 compared to 10% in the year-ago quarter [E25]. This is supported by an aggressive growth-spending phase, shown by a 338.8% surge in Capital Work-in-Progress to Rs 4.3 Cr [E34], all while maintaining a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.30x [E32] and increased promoter skin in the game at 67.74% [E35]. Conceded: the company pays a 0.00% dividend yield [E4] and has experienced recent institutional outflows [E38].
